Chapter 685: Chapter 16 Stepping Into The Tenth Rank (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 685: Chapter 16 Stepping into the Tenth Rank (End of this volume, please subscribe)

In the meantime, as they waited,

the two Supreme Beings also began to chat idly.

“As the Milky Way Star Lord and the first life in our human civilization to receive Chaos Void Origin Infusion at the Ninth Rank, I wonder how large a breach he will tear when he breaks through.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being couldn’t help but be curious.

Even though she had witnessed Eleventh Rank Powerhouses assault the ultimate barrier and accept Chaos Void Origin Infusions numerous times,

a Ninth Rank?

...

It had never happened throughout history.

Even the ultimate beings were quite expectant.

“Typically, a breakthrough from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank will tear a breach stretching a million miles, to allow for Origin Infusion.”

“The Milky Way Star Lord has opened more than two hundred million Spatial Layers; the Origin Power he requires for infusion is twenty times stronger than that of a normal Ninth Rank powerhouse. But the Chaos Void’s Origin is much stronger than the cosmic Origin, so the final breach he will tear is estimated to be around ten million miles.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being speculated.

Whether it’s cosmic Origin Infusion or Chaos Void Origin Infusion,

the essence is to fill the body of an Evolver with Origin Power.

The more Origin the inner world of an Evolver’s physical body can hold, the larger the breach caused by the overflowing Origin will be.

“About right.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being nodded.

While they had not seen a Ninth Rank life receive Chaos Void Origin Infusion,

they could infer the scale of the infusion from the cosmic Origin Infusions normally received by a Ninth Rank Evolver.

Typically, the quality of Chaos Void Origin surpasses cosmic Origin by a hundredfold.

When the Milky Way Star Lord breaks through, the breach he tears open will be a ten million miles wide, and the quality of the Chaos Void Origin pouring in will be ten times that of cosmic Origin.

If one accounts for the quality increase as well, the ultimate benefit the Milky Way Star Lord will receive will be over a thousand times what a normal Ninth Rank Evolver gains from breaking through to Tenth Rank.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, eighteen or nineteen years had gone by.

On the Milky Way Main Star,

Lin Yuan quietly opened his eyes.

“The transformation has reached its pinnacle.”

Lin Yuan observed himself, whether it was the Inner World within his body, his Physical Soul, or even his Spirit Will, they all seemed to have reached a certain limit.

To improve further, he had to break his shackles and step into the Tenth Rank.

Swish.

Swish.

Two figures appeared at his side.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyang and Taiyin Primordial Spirits.

Hum.

With a slight thought from Lin Yuan, the two Primordial Spirits began to operate the secret technique “Illusionary Reality,” transitioning from bodies of flesh and blood back to souls.

This Secret Technique created by the Moyu Tower Master allowed life to freely switch between illusion and reality, truly incredible.

All this time, Lin Yuan had kept his two major Primordial Spirits in their physical forms.

Because only through a physical body could he fully unleash the power of his Physical Body Divine Abilities.

As for the soul form? Even though the soul had the effect of being insubstantial, with the ability to resurrect from a single drop of blood, it wasn’t too different from the soul form.

Additionally, with several other Physical Body Divine Abilities, for Lin Yuan, the advantages of maintaining a body of flesh were far greater than using a soul form.

But now,

to ensure a stable breakthrough,

Lin Yuan decided to let his two major Primordial Spirits return to their original form.

Even though the two Primordial Spirits reverted to soul forms,

the Inner Worlds within did not shrink back to a size of ten million miles in radius.

The effects of the Mysterious Gourd did not disappear with the transition from physical to soul form.

“Let’s start the breakthrough.” Lin Yuan’s two major Primordial Spirits merged back into the physical body, and at this moment, inside his body, three Inner Worlds spanning over two hundred million miles suppressed everything.

“Let’s go.” Lin Yuan’s figure vanished, entering into the deeper Spatial Layers.

…

“Hmm?”

“The kid’s starting his breakthrough.”

The two Supreme Beings, always keeping their attention on the Milky Way Main Star, immediately noticed Lin Yuan’s aura disappear from the Milky Way Main Star and appear in the deeper Spatial Layers.

“Let’s begin our part.”

“Seal space and time.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being locked eyes with the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, and they started to act.

In an instant,

threads of mysterious aura began to spread throughout the entire Milky Way Star Region, and even to the numerous adjacent Star Domains.

In this vast area, space and time were temporarily isolated, so even if something significant happened inside, while the outside world might sense anomalies, they couldn’t pinpoint the exact location.

…

Deep within the Spatial Layers,

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

With the transformation at its pinnacle, Lin Yuan felt an urge welling inside him.

That was to break it,

to crack the bottleneck of shackles.

Rumblings emanated.

As Lin Yuan released his restraints,

he fully assaulted the bottleneck.

The universe outside seemed to sense something.

A terrifying rift tore through the layered space, and an immense amount of Origin Power from beyond the cosmos, from the Chaos Void, began to pour into Lin Yuan frenziedly.

Rustle rustle!

A boundless torrent of Chaos Void Origin Power, seemingly without cost, poured toward Lin Yuan.

A normal Ninth Rank Evolver, upon breaking through to Tenth Rank, required only a small amount of Origin Infusion.

After all, a Ninth Rank Evolver assaulting Tenth Rank only possessed an Inner World of about ten million miles in radius, and the number of Spatial Layers developed was merely about ten million.

How much Origin Power could such a small and shallow space hold?

A small number of special Ninth Rankers, having developed tens of millions of Spatial Layers, might require a bit more Origin Power.

But even that was quite limited.

At most, a breach two million or three million miles wide would be torn to facilitate the Origin Infusion.

But Lin Yuan?

With an inner world directly perceived to span beyond two hundred million miles in diameter, compared to ordinary evolvers whose inner worlds span merely ten million miles, the amount of Origin Power he could bear was a thousandfold, if not a millionfold greater.

Furthermore, within the more than two hundred million miles of his inner world, the number of spatial layers he had opened up exceeded 2.3 billion.

Combining both factors, the Origin Power Lin Yuan ultimately could bear was tens of millions to hundreds of millions of times that of a regular Ninth Rank Evolver.

This was akin to a fish tank compared to a lake—both containing water, yet the quantities of water were worlds apart.

Rip.

Through the numerous spatial layers, causing a massive influx of Chaos Void Origin, the initial rupture spanned over a million miles and continued to grow as time passed, with Lin Yuan bearing ever more of the Origin.

The size of the rupture was rapidly expanding.

One light-year.

Two light-years.

Five light-years.

…

When a normal Ninth Rank Evolver aimed for the Tenth Rank, by retreating into the deeper spatial layers, the commotion caused wouldn’t be too significant, only ripping a gap of a million to several million miles.

In comparison to the vast cosmic void, what was that?

But—

Lin Yuan required an immensely vast amount of Origin.

Even though the quality of Chaos Void Origin was a hundred times stronger than that of the cosmic Origin, the rupture rapidly reached ten light-years.

The energy fluctuations that burst forth were vastly more significant than the disturbance caused by a Ninth Rank breaking through to the Tenth Rank, and even surpassed the commotion of a Tenth Rank advancing to an Eleventh Rank.

…

“What’s going on?”

“The universe has been torn open?”

“Chaos Origin is pouring in?”

At the same moment, in the depths of the cosmic starry skies, various Eleventh Rank lives became aware.

If the universe’s space were only momentarily torn open, or if the rupture wasn’t substantial in force, it would not have triggered such a significant response.

But with a gap spanning over ten light-years, in addition to the release of a considerable amount of Chaos Void Origin atmosphere, Eleventh Rank lives could detect it even from a great distance.

After all, Chaos Void Origin was the force Eleventh Rank Powerhouses needed to challenge the Ultimate Realm, and many Eleventh Rank lives were desperately longing for this kind of energy.

“Is there a life form attempting the Ultimate?”

“Which Eleventh Rank Peak Life has chosen this moment to challenge the Ultimate Realm?”

“No, I’ve witnessed the spectacle of an Eleventh Rank Life challenging the Ultimate, and it was far more intense than what is happening now.”

“Yes, the infusion of Chaos Void Origin is just one of the anomalies that occur when an Eleventh Rank Life challenges the Ultimate; other, even more grandiose manifestations should appear…”

Many powerful Ancient Gods kept communicating. Some Ancient Gods who were in profound slumber, maintaining a vast discrepancy in time flow between themselves and the outside world, were also awakened by the scent of Chaos Void Origin, canceling the time flow disparity to sense the breath from beyond the universe.

“It must be a Tenth Rank Life that has thoroughly comprehended the Rule of Time, now aiming for the Eleventh Realm,” guessed an Ancient God.

Since the birth of the universe.

Never had there been a Ninth Rank Life that grasped the Rule of Time.

But a Tenth Rank Life to have understood the Rule of Time? That had happened before.

A Tenth Rank Life that had understood the Rule of Time, completing the independence of their inner world, would also receive an infusion of the Chaos Void’s Origin when challenging the Eleventh Rank.

“Having comprehended the Rule of Time at Tenth Rank, this would be quite beneficial for the eventual Ultimate Leap, wouldn’t it?”

“I’m envious… Why didn’t I stay at Tenth Rank for a few more years? If I had comprehended the Rule of Time then, I could have had another opportunity to receive the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, which would have been infinitely beneficial…”

“However, I didn’t feel where the rift was torn open; it’s as if space and time have been isolated, giving me an illusion of separation.”

“Hehe, it must be a Supreme Being who made a move, isolating space and time. If it hadn’t been done like this, I’m afraid other hostile Supreme Beings would have taken the chance to strike.”

In the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky, Eleventh-Rank Life forms and Ancient Gods engaged in a lively exchange.

Generally speaking, except for challenges to the Ultimate Realm, there was rarely anything that would prompt such powerful beings to interact, as most were in hibernation.

…

Clan Tianyu.

“The rift was torn open within the territory of Human Civilization.”

A Clan Tianyu Progenitor opened his eyes, looking towards the direction of Human Civilization.

The Eleventh-Rank Lives and Ancient Gods were completely shielded by the isolation of space and time, unable to sense the location of the rift that was continuously infused with Chaos Void Origin.

But as ultimate existences, they could vaguely lock onto the general area.

This progenitor of Clan Tianyu had determined that it was within the territory of Human Civilization.

“Is Human Civilization about to gain an Eleventh-Rank Evolver who comprehended the Rule of Time at Tenth Rank?”

Other progenitors also turned their gaze towards the direction of Human Civilization; for Twelfth-Rank Life forms, it was rare to pay attention to matters below the Ultimate level.

Even the affairs of their own clan were sometimes too trifling for those at the ultimate existence to care about.

But now, a life that had comprehended the Rule of Time at Tenth Rank had caught the attention of many ultimate beings.

At the very least, this being’s chance of making the Ultimate Leap in the future was somewhat greater than that of other Eleventh-Rank Lives.

“The Universal Origin Will favors Human Civilization too much.”

“That event where countless treasures fell from the sky granted Human Civilization the most critical of those treasures.”

“And now another Evolver has emerged who comprehended the Rule of Time at Tenth Rank? And what about the Galaxy Master?”

One ultimate being after another quietly pondered to themselves.

They wanted to eradicate the life that had comprehended the Rule of Time, but for the time being, they could not pinpoint the exact location.

All they knew was it was within Human Civilization Territory.

And the expanse of Human Civilization Territory was vast and widespread; even for the Supreme Beings, searching inch by inch would take a considerable amount of time. What’s more, the ultimates of Human Civilization would not allow Different Species Supreme Beings to search at will.

…

Lin Yuan’s breakthrough had drawn the attention of numerous Eleventh-Rank Lives and ultimate existences.

However, including those ultimate existences, it was merely presumed to be a breakthrough from Tenth to Eleventh Rank.

Nevertheless, this Tenth Rank life had comprehended the Rule of Time and received an early infusion of the Chaos Void Origin.

Though it was somewhat unexpected, similar events had occurred in the past, so it was not too shocking.

However, within the Milky Way Star Region.

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being looked towards the depths of the Spatial Layers, where a rift had reached ten light-years, infinitely infused with Chaos Void Origin.

The breath from outside the universe spread, profound and mysterious.

The two Supreme Beings could vaguely see that outside the Chaos Void, a great amount of Chaos Qi roiled,

The surging Chaos Void Origin seemed to be pouring out, cascading down, and then absorbed by Lin Yuan.

The Chaos Void Origin, capable of bursting both Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers, entered Lin Yuan’s body like into a deep abyss, without causing the slightest reaction.

Like a black hole, Lin Yuan frenziedly absorbed the Origin Infusion from the Chaos Void.

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being stood in shock, motionless for a long time.
